en: Old sepia/black‑and‑white postcard showing two children posing outdoors. The girl wears a bonnet and light dress with a muff; the boy wears a beret, cape coat and boots. A handwritten caption appears on the front margin. The reverse has the classic divided back with the preprinted Hungarian word "LEVELEZŐ‑LAP," blue handwritten notes in Romanian, a museum stamp, and inventory numbers.
